topic: The greatest umpiring controversy — the catch that was never out
hook: The catch that ended a World Cup — was never a catch.
script: The catch that ended a World Cup — was never a catch. In the 1987 World Cup, a fielder claimed a catch that replays showed hit the ground. The batsman was given out. The game changed. No DRS existed. No review. Just one wrong call that changed cricket history forever. Follow for cricket controversies that still cause arguments.
